reviewer_role: independent candidate review followed by implementing-agent final review
reading_task: Compare within-depot shares and counts while preserving subtype groups, reported marker annotations and pooled marginal totals; satisfy the requested brighter palette.

basis: Both candidates are visibly brighter than the baseline.
Candidate A retains stronger small-dot visibility at README width.
Its cyan-to-blue numerical scale combines clearly with coral, jade and violet categories.
Candidate B is softer and its purple highest-share dot echoes the DC categorical color.
Sky-blue marginal bars are brighter than the previous deep blue; coral replaces amber and violet replaces muted pink.
Cyan-to-azure dots show a clear saturated progression on white without introducing a separate categorical hue at the upper end.
The lowest continuous endpoint is more visibly colored than the baseline light blue; dot-size parameters remain exact.
comparison.scope: This fixed 16-subtype by 3-depot panel, evaluated for the user request for brighter colors; no generalization or publication-acceptance claim.

checks.numeric: passed: all 48 original rows and fields verified against original TSV and hashes; 22539 pooled objects retained; plotted-data.csv bytes equal baseline.
checks.mappings: passed: all 16 subtype rows, 88*n/2700 Matplotlib dot-size parameters, depot denominators and fixed linear 0–40% share normalization retained.
checks.palette_order: passed: all 256 sequential-map relative-luminance samples strictly decrease, with no range clipping.
checks.exports: passed: PDF/SVG 180 by 120 mm, PNG 300 dpi, all PDF text 8 pt, embedded Arial and Arial Italic, editable SVG text, no PDF text outside canvas.
checks.legend_geometry: passed: rendered validation has no guide overlap, clipping or geometry issues.
checks.visual: Independent first pass inspected baseline and both candidates; final second pass inspected actual PNG, 1000-pixel README preview and independently rasterized PDF for required labels, row alignment, count label typography, legends, color hierarchy and clipping.

findings.evidence: The n=1 and n=2 dots remain difficult to see when reduced; their exact quantitative sizes are less than or near a raster pixel.
findings.requirement: Preserve all records and exact proportional dot sizes.
findings.action: Retain the colored dots and vector precision; no artificial size floor or replaced values.

residual_notes: Extremely rare positive counts remain tiny at the final physical size and may be difficult to see in a reduced README preview.
